jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Quality Compliance Specialist

Are you a Quality Compliance Specialist looking for a new opportunity?


Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward! Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.


Partner with the best


The Quality Compliance Specialist a role that can have varied responsibilities relating to the maintenance of our Quality Management System (QMS), Multisite Certification Program, conducting of ISO and/or API audits, and ensuring regulatory or industry standards are embedded into our quality systems and processes. The role is specifically focused on within the Oilfield Services Portfolio of Baker Hughes. The Quality Engineer/Specialist, Compliance is a full-time position that reports to the Quality Manager, Compliance.


As a Quality Compliance Specialist, you will be responsible for:


  • Participating in HSE programs as assigned
  • Working areas of the facility in a safe, clean and organized manner at all times in accordance to with 6S Checklist
  • If ever you see anyone around you performing an unsafe act or working in an unsafe condition, immediately Stop Work and report to your lead/supervisor/manager
  • If ever any HSE incident takes place, Stop Work and report immediately to your lead/supervisor/manager •
  • Reviewing all associated ORA’s/HRA’s/MOC’s/Work Permits prior to starting work and exercise Stop Work at any time for Safety
  • Acting as a member of the Internal Audit and Compliance Team in performing evaluation for compliance with regulatory, statutory or industry standards requirements.
  • Assessing compliance of systems, processes and procedures through internal audits
  • Providing feedback in the form of audit findings and observation and review corrective actions
  • Providing regional support on regulatory and industry standards
  • Raise corrective action requests for any nonconformities identified, follow up and review effectiveness until proper closure
  • Serves as a subject matter expert for industry standards, regulatory and stator requirements
  • Identifying and implementing regulatory compliance initiatives based on current and forthcoming regulatory requirements
  • Identifying cost-out opportunities and elevate to lead/supervisor/manager/AMO engineer for review/implementation

Fuel your passion


To be successful in this role you will:


  • Have bachelor's degree (or Global degree equivalent)
  • Have minimum 5 years experience in functional quality experience
  • Have Certified Auditor status ISO 9001:2015 and/or API Q1/API Q2 or deemed subject matter expert industry quality standards
  • Have fluent Azerbaijani and upper-intermediate English
  • Have experience in oil and gas sphere is preferable

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:


  • Standard working hours supporting client's needs

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
 

Working for you
 

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Quality Specialist - Production Regulation
